deadline.value: International applicants apply by December 1 (domestic December 15); year inferred for Fall 2027.
deadline.quote: Mathematics gradmath@colorado.edu 303-492-3161 MA, MS, PhD Subject GRE in Mathematics recommended Fall: December 1 (international), December 15 (domestic)

gre_general.value: The general GRE is not accepted.
gre_general.quote: The general GRE test is not accepted.

gre_subject.value: The Mathematics Subject GRE is optional but strongly recommended; a score above 550 strengthens an application.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Math Subject test is optional, but strongly recommended.

toefl_min.quote: The Mathematics department requires a TOEFL score of at least 100 (internet version)

ielts_min.value: The Graduate School table sets IELTS 7.5 for Math; the department page says 7.0, so plan for 7.5.

also.quote: IELTS score of at least 7.0. This minimum is strictly enforced.

funding.value: Doctoral students are typically supported by a Teaching Assistantship offered with admission (about 8 to 10 funded entrants each year).
funding.quote: Doctoral students are typically supported by a Teaching Assistantship, offered with admission.

entry_route.value: A baccalaureate degree is the entry requirement; a master's is not needed.
entry_route.quote: Applicants must hold a baccalaureate degree from an accredited college or university, or have done work equivalent to that required for such a degree.

supervisor.value: Not stated on the pages checked

notes: Applied Mathematics is a separate department with separate admissions (PhD deadline December 1, GRE listed as required for PhD) and is not covered here.
